cards.ex: I had terrible buyer's remorse after buying that expensive gadget.
cards.exUz: Men qimmatbaho gadjetni sotib olganimdan keyin dahshatli xaridor pushaymoni hissini tuyg'un.
cards.uzDef: Xarid qilgandan keyin afsuslanish, nimaga sotib oldim degan his.

cards.ex: Many freelancers are living hand to mouth when they start out.
cards.exUz: Ko'p frilanserlar ish boshlaganlarida zo'rg'a kun ko'rishadi.
cards.uzDef: Daromad faqat eng zarur ehtiyojlarni qoplashga yetadigan holat.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the repairs?
cards.exUz: Ta'mir uchun menga taxminiy raqamni ayta olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Aniq bo'lmagan, taxminiy narx yoki miqdor.

cards.ex: I'm careful about spending my hard-earned money.
cards.exUz: Men mehnat pulimni sarflashda ehtiyot bo'laman.

cards.ex: They made a killing on that real estate deal.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'chmas mulk bitimidan katta foyda ko'rishdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson yo'l bilan katta miqdorda pul ishlash.

cards.ex: We need to tighten the purse strings because the company's not doing well.
cards.exUz: Biz xarajatni qisqartirishimiz kerak, chunki kompaniya yaxshi ishlayotgani yo'q.

cards.ex: The bottom line is, we can't afford it.
cards.exUz: Asosiy natija shuki, biz buni qurbimiz yetmaydi.

cards.ex: That vacation won't break the bank, will it?
cards.exUz: Bu ta'til bankrot bo'lishga olib kelmaydi, shundaymi?
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p pul sarflash, bankrot bo'lishga yaqinlashish.

cards.ex: The business has been in the red for months.
cards.exUz: Biznes bir necha oydan beri qarzdorlikda.

cards.ex: We're finally in the black after a tough year.
cards.exUz: Qiyin yildan keyin nihoyat foydadamiz.

cards.ex: The politician was accused of a quid pro quo arrangement.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi evaziga evaz kelishuvda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa berib, evaziga boshqa narsa olish.

cards.ex: He's on the gravy train now, with his new job.
cards.exUz: U hozir yangi ishi bilan oson daromadda.

cards.ex: Don't nickel and dime me on the expenses, just pay the bill.
cards.exUz: Xarajatlar uchun mayda pulni hisoblamang, shunchaki hisobni to'lang.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz mayda narsalarga ko'p pul sarflash.

cards.ex: The drinks are on the house tonight!
cards.exUz: Ichimliklar bugun kechqurun muassasa hisobidan!

cards.ex: Tesla is getting a run for its money from other electric car companies.
cards.exUz: Tesla boshqa elektromobillar kompaniyalaridan raqobatga duch kelmoqda.
cards.term: get a run for your money

cards.ex: He received a golden handshake when he retired from the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyadan nafaqaga chiqqanida katta tovon puli oldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdordagi nafaqa yoki tovon puli.

cards.ex: We had to pay through the nose to get tickets to the concert.
cards.exUz: Konsertga chipta olish uchun juda qimmatga to'lashimizga to'g'ri keldi.

cards.ex: Many cities are facing an affordability crisis.
cards.exUz: Ko'p shaharlar qimmatlik inqirozi bilan yuzlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uylar, ta'lim va boshqa zarur narsalarning qimmatlashuvi.

cards.ex: Consumer confidence is rising, which is good for the economy.
cards.exUz: Xaridor ishonchi ortib bormoqda, bu iqtisodiyot uchun yaxshi.

cards.ex: That new car must have cost an arm and a leg.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi mashina juda qimmat turgan bo'lsa kerak.
cards.term: cost an arm and a leg

cards.ex: Her penny-pinching habits annoy her friends.
cards.exUz: Uning o'ta tejamkorlik odatlari do'stlarini g'azablantiradi.
cards.uzDef: O'ta darajada tejamkor bo'lish, har bir tiyinni tejash.

cards.ex: I went on a little retail therapy spree after a bad day at work.
cards.exUz: Ishdagi yomon kundan so'ng men ozgina xarid orqali davolandim.

cards.ex: Their value proposition is that they offer high quality at a low price.
cards.exUz: Ularning qiymat taklifi shundaki, ular yuqori sifatni arzon narxda taklif qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulot yoki xizmatning foydali tomonlarini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: We made a down payment on a new house.
cards.exUz: Biz yangi uyga boshlang'ich to'lov qildik.

cards.ex: Consumer spending is a key indicator of economic health.
cards.exUz: Xaridor xarajatlari iqtisodiy salomatlikning asosiy ko'rsatkichidir.
cards.uzDef: Xaridorlarning mahsulot va xizmatlarga qiladigan xarajatlari.

cards.ex: Many students are debt-ridden after graduating from college.
cards.exUz: Ko'p talabalar kollejni tugatgandan keyin qarzlarga botgan.

cards.ex: The e-commerce boom has transformed the retail industry.
cards.exUz: Elektron tijorat rivoji chakana savdo sanoatini o'zgartirdi.

cards.ex: The government needs to show fiscal responsibility.
cards.exUz: Hukumat moliyaviy mas'uliyatni ko'rsatishi kerak.

cards.ex: The profit margin on this product is very low.
cards.exUz: Ushbu mahsulotning foyda marjasi juda past.

cards.ex: Stakeholder capitalism considers the needs of employees and the environment.
cards.exUz: Benefits kapitalizmi xodimlarning va atrof-muhitning ehtiyojlarini hisobga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Aksiyadorlardan tashqari boshqa tomonlarga ham e'tibor berish
